regime_context: Narrative leadership is extremely concentrated: Banks (cn_banks) are #1, crowded, high-durability, dominant (one_narrative=true), with only 2 of 22 themes trend-eligible. The rotation radar shows a narrow two-theme race (Banks vs Defense) with no confirmed handoff. The backtest verdict is blunt: cross-sectional rank-IC ~0, the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on China A-shares history, and rotation timing has no forward edge — so the detector functions here as coincident context, not a predictive engine. Given track_record direction accuracy of 0.373 and hit rate 0.548 over 126 calls, no view should exceed low conviction.
emerging_watch: Watching Defense & Aerospace (512660.SS): it is the rotation challenger (score 0.525) but trend-ineligible with low durability (0.39) and low breadth (0.385). I am watching for it to become eligible (durability_bar clearing its trend gate) AND to close the Banks-vs-Defense score margin below 0.05 — that would be a CONFIRMED handoff candidate, retiring this watch only if the margin re-widens above 0.15 or Defense remains ineligible for 10 sessions.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the dominant, eligible, high-durability (0.74), high-breadth (0.833) leader with crowding z=1.72. Per guardrails, crowding is NOT a fade signal — but with the absolute-trend gate flagged as did_NOT_hold_here on this market and past direction accuracy near coin-flip, there is no basis to overweight the leader either. The one-narrative structure plus narrow rotation (eligible frac 0.09) means concentrated positioning risk with no validated edge to support adding here.
theses.dissent: Banks are the strongest single theme by every coincident measure (score 0.653, durability 0.74, breadth 0.833) and the only reliable trend-eligible leader — ignoring it entirely forfeits the only stable footing in a market where most themes are mean-reverting.

falsifier.text: Banks (512800.SS) fall below their 20-day breakout level while two or more previously ineligible themes become eligible before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma/CXO is trend-eligible (one of only 2) with moderate durability (0.57) and mixed tag, but is crowded (z=1.38). Crowding is a size-down caution only. The trend gate has no drawdown-control record on this market, and the mixed hurst tag plus only middling breadth (0.5) offers no edge over the dominant Bank narrative. With no confirmed handoff, chasing the only other eligible theme adds position risk without a falsifiable upside.
theses.dissent: It is one of only two eligible themes; if allocation constraints require multiple exposures, Pharma/CXO is the only diversifier with any trend blessing — ignoring it forces single-theme concentration in a one-narrative tape.

falsifier.text: Pharma & CXO (159992.SZ) outperforms Banks (512800.SS) by 3% over a rolling 10-day window before the check-by date.
